messages:
sara: ok team, proposing a 'momentum gate' for the q4v2 quant bring-up. goal: avoid flip-flop promotions from single-minute noise and require sustained positive momentum before increasing traffic.

noah: sounds useful. can you outline the decision rules and how they differ from our existing time-window gates?

sara: short version: measure per-minute relative change on concordance metric, clamp per-minute contributions, take EWMA of those relative deltas as the momentum signal. require momentum > 0.015 for 45m to step up. require immediate rollback on any 10m window with absolute drop < -0.04 or latency breach.

sara: rough config to feed rollout engine (shadow -> tiny burn -> staged):

```json
{
  "gate": "momentum",
  "metrics": ["concordance_v2", "human_score", "latency_p95_ms", "http_5xx_rate"],
  "delta_calc": {"type": "relative_minute_delta", "clamp": {"min": -0.2, "max": 0.2}, "per_minute_cap": 0.06},
  "smoothing": {"method": "ewma", "alpha": 0.1, "lookback_mins": 30},
  "promote": {
    "momentum_gt": 0.015,
    "sustained_mins": 45,
    "min_samples": 300
  },
  "rollback": {
    "any_window_abs_drop_lt": -0.04,
    "window_mins": 10,
    "latency_p95_ms_gt": 130,
    "action": "cut_to_control"
  },
  "ramp": {"start_pct": 0.5, "step_pct": 3, "step_interval_hours": 8, "max_pct": 30},
  "shadow_duration_hours": 48,
  "contrastive_control": "q4v2-nf4"
}
```

cheng: two quick asks: 1) min_samples 300 may be slow for endpoints under 2 QPS. we should add a fallback where duration increases for low-QPS routes. 2) how do we surface the EWMA in dashboards for manual review?

sara: agree on low-QPS fallback  (typo) sorry, meant: fallback = if per_minute_sample_rate < 50 then require 4x sustained_mins. will add variable-duration logic. dashboard: we can expose momentum series and minute-deltas as derived timeseries in the console; plan to add a small panel in the rollout card with those traces and a smoothed threshold line.

noah: add a spike-reject filter so an isolated huge delta doesn't change momentum instantly. maybe ignore minutes with suspiciously low sample counts or with delta magnitude > 0.5 after clamping.

sara: implemented: ignore minute if sample_count < 10 or abs(raw_delta) > 0.5 after clamp. also cap per-minute contribution to 0.06.

adele: ops ask: if rollback happens twice in a 6h window, can we auto-open an incident and pin recent eval slices to it? ops-bot can do that.

ops-bot: note: policy set to open incident when 2 rollbacks in 6h are observed. will attach last 1h of eval slices to incident.

cheng: test plan: shadow q4v2 vs q4v2-nf4 for 48h, collect concordance by seqlen buckets (<=64, 65-256, 257-1024), and by prompt type (instruction, doc-summarize, chat). then run 72h tiny-burn: start 0.5% -> step 3% every 8h up to 15% if all gates pass. final promote if 7d stable and no sustained negative momentum > 0.02.

sara: i'll queue the shadow job for 2026-04-05T02:00Z. tagging @noah @cheng for watch. will post the final runbook + rollback commands (safe_model_id and cut command) here before kickoff. :thumbsup:

noah: please also include a one-line quick revert command in the runbook that platform engineers can run without hunting IDs.

sara: will do. adding a CLI snippet and a pre-authorized cut token. posting back in ~45m with runbook link.

cheng: excited to see whether momentum gate reduces oscillation vs our sliding-window promote. good stuff.

adele: thanks team. ops-bot: please send a reminder 24h before the shadow start to #eng-oncall and #eng-ml.

ops-bot: reminder scheduled for 2026-04-04T02:00Z to channels [#eng-oncall, #eng-ml]. job rbu-shadow-988 queued.
